articles.title: Benito Di Paula morre em São Paulo, aos 84 anos, e deixa obra singular no  samba | G1
articles.body:
O cantor, compositor e músico fluminense Benito Di Paula morre em São Paulo (SP), aos 84 anos, em decorrência de câncer — Foto: Murilo Alvesso

♬ Um dos cantores e compositores mais populares do Brasil nos anos 1970, Benito Di Paula morreu na noite deste domingo, 18 de outubro, aos 84 anos. O artista faleceu no Hospital 9 de julho, em São Paulo (SP), em decorrência de complicações de um câncer de próstata. O artista lutava contra a doença há cerca de um ano. Ainda não há informações sobre o velório e o enterro do cantor.

Cantor, compositor e músico fluminense, Benito Di Paula nasceu Uday Velloso (28 de novembro de 1941 – 18 de outubro de 2026) na cidade de Nova Friburgo (RJ) e foi criado no Rio de Janeiro (RJ). Mas o Brasil já o conheceu como Benito Di Paula a partir dos anos 1970, década em que o artista fez sucesso nacional com um samba diferente, esquema novo .

Benito Di Paula jamais se considerou um sambista da dinastia de Martinho da Vila e Paulinho da Viola, cantores e compositores que também obtiveram grande sucesso na década de 1970 no segmento do samba. Benito sempre se rotulou publicamente como sambeiro e como pianeiro .

Foi no toque percussivo do piano que Benito Di Paula fazia a própria batucada com um suingue brasileiro que, de certa forma, antecipou o pagode paulista que seria propagado nos anos 1990 por grupos como Raça Negra com arranjos cheios de teclados. E o fato é que o sambeiro pianeiro imprimiu assinatura singular na música do Brasil.

Diplomado na escola noturna das boates, território onde constatou que o manuseio das teclas do piano surtia efeito de batucada, Benito Di Paula marcou época nos palcos dos auditórios dos programas de TV com o informal visual de gala composto por anéis, casacas, colares, gravatas borboletas, pulseiras e, claro, os cabelos longos e outrora cacheados. Quem viveu no Brasil ao longo dos anos 1970 lembra da figura de Benito.

O cantor debutou no mercado fonográfico em 1967 e lançou em 1971 o primeiro álbum, “Benito Di Paula” (1971), ao qual se sucedeu o segundo, “Ela” (1972), apresentado um ano depois com o primeiro sucesso do artista, “Violão não se empresta a ninguém” (1972).

Contudo, o reinado de Benito Di Paula começou de fato em 1973 com dolente samba-canção, “Retalhos de cetim”, apresentado em single blockbuster naquele ano de 1973.

“Retalhos de cetim” foi o ponto de partida para o sucesso de obra que – calcada no mix do piano tocado pelo artista com instrumentos de percussão – rendeu sucessivos hits até 1984, mas sobretudo no período que foi de 1973 a 1977.

Nesse período, foi impossível ignorar “Charlie Brown” (1974), “Beleza que é você mulher” (1974), “Bandeira do samba” (1975), “Como dizia o mestre” (1975), “Vai ficar na saudade” (1975), “Tudo está no seu lugar” (1976), “Do jeito que a vida quer” (1976, grande samba dos versos confessionais “...É que meu samba me ajuda na vida / Minha dor vai passando esquecida”), “Assobiar e chupar cana” (1977) e “Proteção às borboletas” (1977).

Apresentadas ao longo de quatro anos, no já mencionado período de 1973 a 1977, auge da carreira de Benito, essas músicas atestaram o talento do compositor para fazer samba descolado da matriz do gênero, ainda que a assumida maior influência do sambeiro tenha sido a obra do bamba Ataulfo Alves (1909 – 1969).

Lançados em discos editados pelo cantor na gravadora Copacabana, na qual Benito permaneceu até 1980 e para a qual voltou brevemente em 1987 e em 1992, esses sucessos da década de 1970 já são suficientes para garantir a imortalidade de Benito Di Paula na galeria dos criadores da música do Brasil.

Contudo, o cantor ainda emplacou eventuais hits na primeira metade da década de 80. “Ah! Como eu amei”, música dos irmãos Jota Vellozo e Nei Vellozo, garantiu a Benito bom lugar nas playlists de 1981. Parceria de Benito com Márcio Brandão Carneiro, “Amigo do sol, amigo da lua” (1984) tocou bem nas rádios e na TV.

Tema da trilha sonora da novela “A gata comeu” (TV Globo, 1985), “Amigo do sol, amigo da lua” foi o último sucesso de Benito Di Paula, ainda que o cantor tenha continuado a lançar discos com regularidade até 1996, ano em que apresentou o álbum “Baileiro” sem repercussão.

Desde então alijado do mercado fonográfico pela máquina das gravadoras, Benito Di Paula apresentou somente mais dois álbuns com músicas inéditas, “A felicidade é nossa” (2017) e o relativamente recente “O infalível zen” (2021), disco com o qual celebrou 80 anos de vida.

Nos últimos anos, a obra inovadora de Benito Di Paula passou por processo de reavaliação e gerou tributos na área fonográfica e também no Carnaval. Em 2025, o artista foi enredo da escola de samba Águia de Ouro, uma das mais importantes do Carnaval paulistano. A agremiação desfilou com o enredo “Em Retalhos de Cetim, a Águia de Ouro do jeito que a vida quer” e com a presença do próprio Benito, emocionado, em um dos carros alegóricos.

No entanto, o aval mais importante, o do público, sempre foi dado de imediato a esse cantor, compositor e instrumentista que deixa o nome gravado na história da música popular do Brasil ao morrer a um mês de completar 85 anos.

Benito Di Paula (1941 – 2026) na capa de álbum de 1976, lançado no período áureo do cantor e compositor — Foto: Reprodução / Capa de disco

articles.title: Cindy Crawford, Kaia Gerber Break Their Silence on Presley Gerber’s Death: “A Sweet, Beautiful Soul”
articles.summary: Crawford's son Presley died in September at age 27.
articles.body:
Cindy Crawford and Kaia Gerber are breaking their silence following the death of Presley Gerber, at age 27 last month.

Crawford took to her Instagram on Sunday to share a heartfelt tribute for her son, writing, "We are beyond heartbroken to lose our beloved son and brother. We feel so blessed to have had Presley in our lives for 27 years."

"He is a sweet, beautiful soul who loved and is loved, now and forever. We are so proud of how he showed up in the world, with kindness and vulnerability," the model and actress continued. "We are grateful for the outpouring of love and support from so many who know and love our family and even strangers who feel our pain. Til we meet again our sweet boy. We love you forever, Mom, Dad and Kaia."

Crawford also shared a black-and-white photo of Presley and thanked artist Sebastian Faena for "capturing this beautiful image."

Kaia, who is Presley's young sister, also took to Instagram Sunday to share a lengthy tribute. "Prez, I don't have the words, and maybe the tiny mercy is that we didn't need them all along. Words fail and words subtract and words summarize and words always lack truth. And how naive of me to believe that language could transcend grief."

"I've read all of the books and I have none of the answers. My articulation is no match against this, the magnitude of losing you. I am, quite literally, down on my fucking knees," she continued. "You know how much I loved being your sister. It has always been, and will forever be, my favorite thing about myself. I came into this world with a white-knuckle grip around you. I had more love for you than I knew what to do with. And now that it has nowhere obvious to go, I'm certain it's going to swallow me whole."

"My best buddy, my great protector, the hardest I've ever laughed and the one true love of my life — you lit all my candles and took all of my monsters away. And I love you," Kaia later added.

The Hollywood Reporter previously reported that Presley died at a rehab facility on Sept. 20, according to the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner. His official cause of death has yet to be revealed.

Presley was Crawford and Rande Gerber's eldest child, and the older brother of model-actress Kaia, who most recently appeared in Ryan Murphy's The Shards.

He began modeling as a teen, signing with IMG Models at age 15. He also worked with several brands throughout his career, including Moschino, Dolce & Gabbana and Calvin Klein, among others.

Before his death, Presley had been open about his struggles with his mental health, depression and substance abuse.

articles.title: Vidyut Jammwal's 'Street Fighter' tops box office with USD 51 million global opening; Elizabeth Holmes movie 'You Can See Everything' a hit in theaters
articles.summary: North American movie theaters were flooded with new films this weekend, including a video game reboot, a big budget survival thriller and a Jane Austen
articles.body: North American movie theaters were flooded with new films this weekend, including a video game reboot, a big budget survival thriller and a Jane Austen adaptation.Paramount's 'Street Fighter' took the first-place spot, earning USD 31 million from 3,575 theaters according to studio estimates on Sunday. The film topped the charts as expected with a USD 51 million global opening, including USD 20 million from international showings. The movie starring Callina Liang, Noah Centineo and Andrew Koji cost a reported $82 million to make, not accounting for marketing and promotion. Audiences were 69% male.'You Can See Everything' had thousands of selloutsmost of the attention and cultural discourse was elsewhere: On the nearly three-hour Elizabeth Holmes documentary, 'You Can See Everything'.Buzz and box office don't always line up, but 'You Can See Everything' made an extraordinary USD 15 million from only 855 screens, with over 2,000 sellout showings over the weekend, according to A24. It also had the biggest opening for a film playing on under 1,000 screens since 'Borat' opened to USD 26.5 million in 2006, and the biggest nonmusic documentary opening in two decades, since 'Fahrenheit 9/11' made nearly USD 24 million from 868 theaters. Those numbers do not account for inflation.Like other hits this year, like the Gen-Z driven 'Backrooms' and 'Obsession', ticket sales for 'You Can See Everything' were driven by a largely younger audience. Over 70% of the opening weekend crowd was under 35.The film, directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim, was made in secret over three years. Fielder spent over a month with the disgraced Theranos founder and her family, including two young children and partner Billy Evans, in her final days before reporting to federal prison. The reviews have been extremely positive, with 99% on Rotten Tomatoes and 99 on Metacritic. It also got an unprecedented 91% "definite recommend" from audiences, according to PostTrak exit polls.The film reportedly cost under $7 million to make and less than $10 million to market.'Street Fighter' knocks out 'Whalefall'Both 'Street Fighter' and 'You Can See Everything' may have contributed to the relative failure of 'Whalefall' this weekend. The USD 60 million survival thriller starring Austin Abrams and Josh Brolin made USD 8 million from 3,065 locations in the U.S. and Canada, despite being better reviewed than 'Street Fighter'. With USD 9.5 million from international showings, the Disney release had a USD 17.5 million global launch.'Whalefall' opened in fourth place, behind the Jessica Chastain horror 'Other Mommy'. The Universal Pictures release added USD 8.4 million in its second weekend, bringing its domestic total to USD 44.9 million.'Sense and Sensibility' off to USD 7.3 million startFifth place went to 'Sense and Sensibility', which earned an estimated USD 7.3 million from 2,545 theaters. The well-reviewed Austen adaptation starring Daisy Edgar-Jones drew a predominantly younger (58% between the ages of 14 and 18) and female crowd (84%). It also got the strongest CinemaScore of the week (A-).Warner Bros. Clockwork also released a restored presentation of Ken Russell's 1971 film 'The Devils' in 350 locations, where it made USD 1.6 million. It's the first release from the studio's specialty label.'Musk' documentary facing advertising blocks and Netflix shares box office for 'La Bola Negra'Alex Gibney's Elon Musk documentary 'Musk' also expanded to 472 screens in the U.S. and Canada, where it made USD 306,702. The film, which runs nearly four hours, has faced issues advertising on major social media platforms including X, which Musk owns, and TikTok, according to distributor Bleecker Street, which said TikTok this weekend permanently suspended the film's ad account.Netflix also shared ticket sales for the first time for the queer Spanish epic 'La Bola Negra', which made USD 277,500 from four locations this weekend. The streamer has not historically reported box office for its theatrical releases, but this film is breaking new ground as it's being positioned as a possible best picture contender. It will be in theaters for 47 days before it will be available to watch on Netflix.According to Rentrak, the weekend overall generated about USD 101.6 million in ticket sales, up 45% from the same weekend last year. The year to date stands at USD 8.2 billion, which is up almost 20% from 2025.Top 10 movies at the domestic box officeWith final domestic figures being released Monday, this list factors in the estimated ticket sales for Friday through Sunday at U.S. and Canadian theaters, according to Rentrak:1. "Street Fighter," $31 million.2. "You Can See Everything," $15 million.3. "Other Mommy," $8.4 million.4. "Whalefall," $8 million.5. "Sense and Sensibility," $7.3 million.6. "Verity," $6.2 million.7. "Resident Evil," $5.5 million.8. "Heart of the Beast," $4.8 million.9. "Jailer 2," $3.2 million.10. "Forgotten Island," $2.3 million.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Taylor Swift cheers for husband Travis Kelce at Chiefs vs Chargers game with WNBA star Caitlin Clark
articles.summary: Taylor Swift was back in the stands to support her husband, Travis Kelce, as the Kansas City Chiefs took on the Los Angeles Chargers in Kansas City.
articles.body: Taylor Swift was back in the stands to support her husband, Travis Kelce, as the Kansas City Chiefs took on the Los Angeles Chargers in Kansas City. The singer watched the game from the usual VIP suite at Arrowhead Stadium alongside WNBA star Caitlin Clark, friend Este Haim and mother-in-law, Donna Kelce.Swift made a quick style switch for the sporting event, trading her glamorous blue evening gown from the Academy Museum Gala in Los Angeles for a cherry-red turtleneck and skirt. She completed the look with gold hoop earrings and a matching ring. The singer also swapped her blonde wavy do for a straighter, shoulder-length bob.Taylor Swift turns cheerleader for hubby Travis KelceTaylor Swift joined by Caitlin Clark and Este HaimPhotos from the match saw Swift sharing a hug with her mother-in-law, Donna, during the game, while Clark and Haim joined her in the stadium suite.Taylor Swift attends Academy Museum GalaThe appearance came less than 24 hours after Swift attended the Academy Museum Gala in Los Angeles, where she surprised the audience with the live debut of ‘The Fate of Ophelia’ during a short performance on Saturday.Despite the single having been released more than a year earlier, Swift had not performed ‘The Fate of Ophelia’ live before, nor had she performed any track from the chart-topping collection, according to the report. Her set also featured ‘I Knew It, I Knew You’, along with fan favourites ‘Blank Space’ and ‘Love Story’.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Documentário de Brasília mostra espera de mulheres com câncer de mama por tratamento no SUS | G1
articles.standfirst: Filme Esse Outubro Não É Rosa será exibido na quinta-feira (22), no Cine Brasília, com debate sobre filas de regulação e acesso à saúde.
articles.summary: Filme Esse Outubro Não É Rosa será exibido na quinta-feira (22), no Cine Brasília, com debate sobre filas de regulação e acesso à saúde.
articles.body:
Documentário 'Esse Outubro Não É Rosa' será exibido na quinta-feira (22), às 19h, no Cine Brasília. — Foto: Divulgação

Um documentário produzido em Brasília promete mostrar a realidade de mulheres com câncer de mama que enfrentam a demora para conseguir exames, diagnósticos e tratamentos pelo Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS).

O longa Esse Outubro Não É Rosa , dirigido por Luciana Salvatore, será exibido na quinta-feira (22), às 19h, no Cine Brasília, na Asa Sul.

Após a sessão, haverá um debate com a diretora, personagens do filme, especialistas e profissionais de saúde . A recepção ao público e o coquetel começam às 18h.

Lançado em outubro de 2025, o documentário aborda as dificuldades enfrentadas por pacientes que precisam lidar com a doença enquanto aguardam atendimento na rede pública. A produção também propõe uma reflexão sobre as desigualdades no acesso à saúde e os impactos da demora no tratamento.

Histórias de mulheres que enfrentam o câncer

O documentário acompanha Fátima e Rafaella, duas mulheres que sobreviveram ao câncer de mama e que, após a recidiva da doença, voltaram a enfrentar os desafios do tratamento.

Enquanto aguardam exames, diagnósticos e procedimentos, as protagonistas lidam com a incerteza e com a urgência de iniciar o atendimento. As histórias expõem as dificuldades de quem depende da rede pública de saúde para dar continuidade ao tratamento.

Para Grace Justa, diretora do Instituto de Desenvolvimento Humano Umanizzare, parceiro da produção, o filme busca dar visibilidade às falhas no atendimento e estimular o debate sobre as filas de regulação.

Segundo Grace, o documentário também aborda a responsabilidade coletiva diante dos problemas estruturais que dificultam o acesso ao atendimento.

O longa conquistou cinco prêmios internacionais. Entre eles estão o de Melhor Filme Independente no Cannes Arts Film Fest; os de Melhor Filme de Longa-Metragem e Melhor Direção de Longa-Metragem, para Luciana Salvatore, no Indiana Independent Film Festival; o de Melhor Narrativa Feminina de Longa-Metragem no Calgary Independent Film Festival; e o de Melhor Longa-Metragem sobre Empoderamento Feminino no London Women Film Festival.

articles.title: 'Jailer 2' box office collection day 4: Rajinikanth, Mohanlal, Nelson Dilipkumar film sees Sunday jump; earns Rs 55.85 cr in India; worldwide gross hits Rs 424.25 cr
articles.summary: Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' continued its strong box office run on Sunday, October 18, collecting Rs 55.85 cr net in India on its fourth day.
articles.body: Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' continued its strong box office run on Sunday, October 18, collecting Rs 55.85 cr net in India on its fourth day. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the action entertainer recorded an overall occupancy of 62% across 15,473 shows. According to Sacnilk, the film's worldwide gross collection has reached Rs 424.25 cr, including earnings from domestic and overseas markets.Jailer 2 ReviewThe fourth-day collection also marks an 18.2% increase over Saturday's India net collection of Rs 47.25 cr. With this, the film's cumulative India net collection stands at Rs 199.90 cr, while its domestic gross has reached Rs 234.25 cr. The film has also crossed the Rs 150 cr net collection milestone in India. 'Jailer 2' box office collection day-wise'Jailer 2' began its theatrical run with Rs 59.70 cr net in India on Thursday, October 15. The film recorded 55.4% occupancy across 16,599 shows. On Friday, October 16, collections dropped to Rs 37.10 cr from 13,157 shows, with occupancy at 48.2%.The Rajinikanth-starrer recovered on Saturday, October 17, earning Rs 47.25 cr from 14,604 shows at 53.9% occupancy. Sunday brought another increase, with collections reaching Rs 55.85 cr and occupancy rising to 62%. The film recorded 3,687,269 footfalls on Day 4, taking its total footfalls over four days to 13,021,526.The Tamil version remained the biggest contributor on Sunday, earning Rs 39.95 cr net from 8,173 shows at 80% occupancy. The Telugu version collected Rs 9.50 cr across 2,234 shows, registering 64.3% occupancy. The Hindi version added Rs 5.75 cr from 4,902 shows at 31% occupancy, while the Kannada version earned Rs 0.65 cr across 164 shows, with occupancy at 61%.The Tamil version recorded 82.58% overall occupancy in 2D screenings. Morning shows registered 67.08%, while afternoon, evening and night screenings recorded 87.08%, 88.77% and 87.38%, respectively.The Hindi version registered 44.40% overall occupancy, with morning shows at 28.58%, afternoon screenings at 49.83%, evening shows at 47.83% and night screenings at 46%. Meanwhile, the Telugu version recorded 61.81% overall occupancy. Its morning shows registered 41.92%, followed by 70.58% in the afternoon, 71.83% in the evening and 62.92% at night.Overseas collection pushes worldwide total past Rs 424 cr'Jailer 2' collected Rs 40 cr from overseas markets on Day 4, taking its cumulative overseas gross to Rs 190 cr. Combined with its India gross of Rs 234.25 cr, the film's worldwide gross has reached Rs 424.25 cr.Shamna Kasim expresses gratitude to Rajinikanth and teamMeanwhile, actor Shamna Kasim has thanked audiences for their response to her dance appearance in 'Jailer 2'. She also expressed gratitude to director Nelson Dilipkumar, producer Kalanithi Maran and composer Anirudh Ravichander for giving her the opportunity to be part of the film.In a social media video, Shamna Kasim spoke about sharing screen space with Rajinikanth, whom she has admired for years. She also mentioned 'Padayappa' as one of her favorite films featuring the veteran actor."Everyone would like to share screen space with a style icon such as Rajinikanth sir. I never thought that I would have that opportunity," Shamna said. 'Jailer 2' cast and special appearancesRajinikanth returns as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian in the sequel. The supporting cast includes S.J. Suryah as Bodhi Kalpak, Mithun Chakraborty as Chakri, Suraj Venjaramoodu as Dileep, Ramya Krishnan, Vidya Balan and Yogi Babu. The film also features special appearances by Mohanlal, Shivarajkumar and Jackie Shroff.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. articles.title: Tiger Shroff covers face, reaches home under police protection after Juhu firing; tape on hand draws attention
articles.summary: Tiger Shroff was moved to safety under police protection after shots were fired in Mumbai’s Juhu on Sunday, October 18, 2026.
articles.body: Tiger Shroff was moved to safety under police protection after shots were fired in Mumbai’s Juhu on Sunday, October 18, 2026. Social media videos show the actor in a vehicle, flanked by security. Though tape on his hand drew attention online, police confirmed he sustained no bullet injuries.Videos show Tiger Shroff leaving under police escortAn Instagram video posted by the paparazzi shows Tiger sitting in a vehicle while police officers take him away from the scene. According to the account, the Mumbai Police provided the actor with protection and escorted him to his home. A second clip shows the vehicle ringed by security personnel, suggesting extra precautions were put in place after the shooting. That said, where Tiger was actually taken has not been independently verified.Tape on Tiger Shroff’s hand draws attentionOne detail drawing attention in the circulating visuals is what looks like dressing tape on Tiger’s hand. It isn’t clear whether the tape relates to the firing incident. Police have said Tiger suffered no gunshot injuries, and his father, Jackie Shroff, also moved to reassure the media. His team told India Today that “Tiger is okay.”Tiger Shroff’s car attacked after football sessionThe attack reportedly took place as Tiger was heading back from a football session near Pushpa Park. Unknown assailants are said to have fired three shots at his vehicle. Tiger was not hit, but his driver, named Firdaus, was wounded in the left arm, and an autorickshaw driver was also reported to be hurt. Both Tiger and his driver were rushed to Nanavati Hospital after the incident.Gang claim in Tiger Shroff firing case under scrutinyMeanwhile, a social media message linked to alleged Bishnoi gang members Anil Pandit and Harman Sandhu claims they carried out the attack and warns Bollywood against working with Salman Khan. Police say the message is unverified and the gang’s role is not established. Several teams are reviewing CCTV and other evidence to trace the attackers.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. Download the TOI app.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: 'Ranabaali' box office collection day 3: Vijay Deverakonda, Rashmika Mandanna film earns Rs 7.50 cr; worldwide gross reaches Rs 36.90 cr; Sunday sees slight growth
articles.summary: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna's 'Ranabaali' recorded a marginal increase in box office collections on Sunday, October 18.
articles.body: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna's 'Ranabaali' recorded a marginal increase in box office collections on Sunday, October 18. The historical drama earned Rs 7.50 cr net in India on its third day, according to Sacnilk. The film's worldwide gross collection has reached Rs 36.90 cr, including earnings from domestic and overseas markets.The film collected Rs 24.05 cr net in India, while its domestic gross stood at Rs 28 cr. Overseas markets contributed Rs 1.50 cr on Day 3, taking the cumulative overseas gross to Rs 8.90 cr. Sunday's India net collection marked a 2.7% rise over Saturday's Rs 7.30 cr. Despite the slight recovery, the film's daily earnings remain below its opening-day figures.'Ranabaali' box office collection day-wiseDirected by Rahul Sankrityan, 'Ranabaali' opened in theaters on Friday, October 16, with Rs 9.25 cr net in India. The film recorded 57% occupancy across 2,515 shows. On Saturday, October 17, collections dropped to Rs 7.30 cr from 2,292 shows, while occupancy stood at 53%.The film registered a small improvement on Sunday, earning Rs 7.50 cr from 2,302 shows. Occupancy increased to 56%, compared with Saturday's 53%. The film recorded 578,686 footfalls on Day 3, taking its total footfalls over the first three days to 1,842,311.'Ranabaali' Telugu version records 54.53% occupancyThe Telugu version registered 54.53% overall occupancy across 2D screenings on Sunday. Morning shows recorded 31.15%, while afternoon screenings reached 65.62%. Evening shows registered 61.38%, followed by 57.69% during night screenings.The afternoon and evening shows recorded higher occupancy than the morning screenings.State-wise box office collection on Day 3The state-wise gross collection report listed Rs 7.25 cr from Andhra Pradesh and Telangana on Sunday, October 18. Karnataka contributed Rs 1.05 cr, while Tamil Nadu added Rs 0.20 cr. The rest of India category accounted for Rs 25 lakhs.The reported state-wise total gross collection for the day was Rs 8.75 cr. This figure differs from the India net collection of Rs 7.50 cr, as gross earnings include applicable taxes. The film's overall domestic net and gross totals stood at Rs 24.05 cr and Rs 28 cr, respectively, after three days.Rashmika Mandanna compares Vijay Deverakonda's performance to Allu Arjun in 'Pushpa 2'Meanwhile, Rashmika Mandanna discussed Vijay Deverakonda's performance at a press conference in Hyderabad on Friday. The event took place after 'Ranabaali' arrived in theaters on October 16 and received mixed reviews. Rashmika said watching Vijay transform into his character reminded her of Allu Arjun's performance in Sukumar's 'Pushpa 2: The Rule'.“Of course, there was a similar experience in Pushpa 2 when Bunny sir was doing that. Bunny sir as Bunny sir and Bunny sir as Pushpa were two different people,” she said.Rashmika also reflected on how Vijay's performance felt different from their previous collaborations, 'Geetha Govindam' and 'Dear Comrade'. She explained that seeing him work on set gave her a new perspective on his acting.“Like that, when I saw Viju…I’ve seen him personally at home. When I saw him on set, it was just different. The actors who perform know the feeling. But genuinely speaking, we did Geetha Govindam and Dear Comrade, I feel like Ranabaali and Jayamma touched me. It felt different this time. For me, with the overall film, I have to say it’s him. He’s a one-man show.”'Ranabaali' stars Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna, with Rahul Sankrityan directing the 2026 historical drama. The film brings the lead actors together again after their earlier collaborations in 'Geetha Govindam' and 'Dear Comrade'.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. articles.title: Tiger Shroff firing incident: Ahsaas Channa calls it scary; Amol Parashar says, ‘Whoever has broken the law should be caught and punished’
articles.summary: Several actors have expressed shock after shots were fired at Tiger Shroff’s car in Mumbai, raising concerns about safety in the entertainment industry.
articles.body: Several actors have expressed shock after shots were fired at Tiger Shroff’s car in Mumbai, raising concerns about safety in the entertainment industry. Ahsaas Channa, Nishant Malkani, Amol Parashar, Apoorva Arora, Alam Khan and Riva Arora reacted to the incident on Sunday. While Tiger Shroff escaped without gunshot injuries, two people were hurt in the firing, according to the police, as reported by ANI.Ahsaas Channa hopes Tiger Shroff remains safeAhsaas Channa said she was relieved that Tiger Shroff had escaped unharmed but remained concerned about his safety. She also hoped he would remain safe in the future."I am very, very happy that he is safe. But I am also a little scared for him. I hope he is okay and even in the future he is always safe," she told ANI. Ahsaas Channa said more information was needed before drawing conclusions about the incident or connecting it to the city."I don't think that this is related to the city. I think we need to know more about it and need more information, only then can we comment on it," she added.She also urged people to take precautions and expressed hope that the police would respond appropriately. "I think everyone should take very careful measures. I hope the police is cooperating," she said.Nishant Malkani and Amol Parashar reactNishant Malkani said he was unaware of the shooting until he was asked about it. He planned to contact Tiger Shroff to check on his well-being."It's very shocking news. I didn't know about it. I'll check and I'll call him," Nishant Malkani said. He expressed sadness over the incident and said such events should not happen."It's a sad thing. What can we say? Such things should not happen, that's it," he added.Amol Parashar described the incident as frightening and said news of violence often worries actors' families. He recalled how his parents would contact him to check where he was whenever they heard similar reports."Such things are shocking and scary too. I think everyone gets scared. My parents, whenever they hear this news, will first call or message and ask where I am and whether I am outside," he said.Amol Parashar also called for strict action against anyone found guilty, saying punishment could help prevent further crimes."Whoever has broken the law, whoever has done something wrong, should be caught and punished. The way to reduce crime is to catch criminals and punish them. If they don't get punished, other people will also get encouragement to do wrong things," he said.Apoorva Arora and Alam Khan express concernApoorva Arora said she had only recently heard about the incident and hoped everyone involved was safe. She also expressed hope that justice would be served."I actually just found out inside and it's very unfortunate that this happened. I hope everything is okay and everyone is okay. I haven't seen the news yet, but someone informed me about this. It's very, very unfortunate that in a city like this, this is happening. I hope there is justice," Apoorva Arora said in an interaction with ANI.She added that the incident was difficult to process but expressed faith in Mumbai's safety and administration."It's very scary, honestly. There are no words to genuinely process it because I have just found out. I would like to believe that Mumbai city is still safe and will remain safe, thanks to the Mumbai Police and administration here," she said.Alam Khan also said he was shocked by the news and did not know what had led to the shooting."I just saw the news. In fact, it was very shocking. I really don't know what the reason could be," he said.Riva Arora calls the incident frighteningRiva Arora said the shooting was frightening and hoped Tiger Shroff was safe. She noted that such incidents could leave people feeling vulnerable."Oh my God. It's scary actually. Sometimes it gets so scary for an actor, for everybody. Suddenly, you don't know when what will happen. I really hope he is okay," she said.Questioning the reasons behind such acts, Riva Arora said they could cause significant emotional distress."I don't know. I just don't understand what people get by doing all this. It's very scary for somebody also to experience this and it gives you a different level of trauma," she said. She also described the situation as "crazy" and difficult to comprehend.Mumbai Police deploy 15 teams for investigationReportedly, the Mumbai Police have formed 15 teams to investigate the firing. According to the police, three to four rounds were fired at Tiger Shroff's car as he was leaving a ground where a large crowd had gathered to see him. The shots were reportedly fired from within the crowd.Tiger Shroff did not sustain any gunshot injuries. However, two people were injured, including his driver, Firdaus, who suffered a gunshot wound to his left arm. The police are continuing their investigation to establish the circumstances surrounding the incident and identify those responsible. articles.title: 'Prahaar' box office collection day 3: Rajkummar Rao’s courtroom drama sees slight growth on Sunday,  but misses Rs 10 crore mark during the opening weekend
articles.summary: Rajkummar Rao’s 'Prahaar: The Ujjwal Nikam Story' had a muted opening at the box office on Friday.
articles.body: Rajkummar Rao’s 'Prahaar: The Ujjwal Nikam Story' had a muted opening at the box office on Friday. Business improved a little over the weekend, but the increase was too modest to make a real difference to the film’s overall numbers.‘Prahaar’ box office: Slow start, modest weekend growth'Prahaar: The Ujjwal Nikam Story' hit theatres on Friday, October 16, and brought in Rs 2.35 crore net in India on day one, per Sacnilk. Occupancy stood at just 13%, making it one of the weaker openings in Rajkummar Rao’s career. Saturday saw a pickup, with collections rising about 34% to Rs 3.15 crore and occupancy climbing to 17%, a sign that more people were turning up as the weekend began. Sunday held steady at roughly the same level, with the film earning Rs 3.50 crore. Over its first three days, the film has collected a total of Rs 9 crore net in India.‘Prahaar’ trails ‘Nayyi Navelli’ at the box officeThe film is not leading its own release window, though. Yami Gautam’s 'Nayyi Navelli', which opened the same day, has stayed ahead and crossed Rs 10 crore over the same three-day period.What is ‘Prahaar’ about?In 'Prahaar: The Ujjwal Nikam Story', Rajkummar Rao steps into the shoes of public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam in a courtroom biopic directed by Avinash Arun. The film chronicles key moments from Nikam’s career, chief among them the case against Ajmal Kasab, the only attacker captured alive during the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks. It also shows the struggles and obstacles that come with fighting for justice in headline-making criminal cases. The ensemble includes Wamiqa Gabbi, Jaideep Ahlawat, Sikandar Kher and Lalit Prabhakar, who appears as Kasab.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Tiger Shroff firing: Ranvir Shorey, Rahul Dholakia slam attack, say ‘criminals are shooting innocents’
articles.summary: On October 18, 2026, three unidentified attackers targeted Tiger Shroff in a firing incident, injuring two people, including his driver.
articles.body: On October 18, 2026, three unidentified attackers targeted Tiger Shroff in a firing incident, injuring two people, including his driver. The actor escaped unharmed. Police have formed 15 teams to probe the case from multiple angles, while Ranvir Shorey and Rahul Dholakia strongly condemned the incident.Ranvir Shorey reacts to Tiger Shroff firingTaking to X (formerly Twitter), Ranvir wrote, “Shocking and disgusting! Hope everyone is safe, @iTIGERSHROFF @bindasbhidu! No mercy for the perpetrators, @MumbaiPolice! This is outrageous!”.Rahul Dholakia questions law and orderFilmmaker Rahul Dholakia wrote, “What kind of Law and order is this ?? The ones who are harmless are sent to jail – the ones who are criminals are shooting innocents on the street ! A gangster who is in Jail openly threatens Bollywood and shoots at will -and we just allow fear to spread ! Who is answerable ?? @AmitShah @Dev_Fadnavis could u please address the state / city / resident of Juhu?? Or are you still worried about harmless flag walkers!".Driver Firdous’s statement recorded by Mumbai PoliceTiger Shroff’s driver, Firdous, has had his statement recorded by Mumbai Police as part of the probe into the firing incident. He is currently hospitalised at Nanavati Hospital, where he is being treated for his injuries. Early reports suggested that the actor and two others were hurt, but Mumbai Police later clarified that he was safe and had no gunshot injuries. The two people reportedly injured were Shroff’s driver and an autorickshaw driver.Where did the Tiger Shroff firing take place?The incident happened near Pushpa Park in Juhu on Sunday, October 18. Shroff had reportedly gone out to play football and was heading back home when the shots were fired. Initial reports suggest that a crowd had gathered in the area to get a glimpse of the actor when the assailants allegedly opened fire.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'He believed in me, I am very grateful to him': Mamitha Baiju thanks Girish AD for trusting her with 'Bethlehem Kudumba Unit'
articles.summary: Mollywood actress Mamitha Baiju has expressed gratitude to filmmaker Girish AD for believing in her and offering her a key role in 'Bethlehem Kudumba
articles.body: Mollywood actress Mamitha Baiju has expressed gratitude to filmmaker Girish AD for believing in her and offering her a key role in 'Bethlehem Kudumba Unit'. The film, starring Nivin Pauly and Mamitha Baiju, became a major box-office success and continues to receive positive responses following its OTT release.Speaking at the film's success celebration, the actress recalled how Girish AD had narrated the story to her soon after the shoot of 'Super Sharanya' wrapped up. She said she had not expected the filmmaker to place such confidence in her at the time.Mamitha Baiju recalls Girish AD narrating the storyMamitha Baiju revealed that Girish AD had approached her with the story of 'Bethlehem Kudumba Unit' before 'Super Sharanya' was even released. The filmmaker had already felt she would be suitable for the character, although she did not understand what made him so confident about her.“After 'Super Sharanya', the film’s shoot had just wrapped up, and it had not been released yet. Girish chettan told me the story of 'Bethlehem' at that time itself. He said then that it would be good if I played this character. Even today, I don’t know what made Girish chettan say that to me or what gave him the confidence to trust me.Now, as I stand here at the success meet of 'Bethlehem', all I have to say to Girish chettan is thank you. When someone stands by a person like me, who is practically nothing, there is a certain value they give that person. That is how I feel about Girish chettan. Whether it was 'Premalu' or 'Bethlehem', at a time when I didn’t even believe I could play a main heroine’s role like this, he believed in me. I am very grateful to him,” Mamitha said, as quoted by Reporter website.Mamitha Baiju thanks the cast and crewAt the success celebration of 'Bethlehem Kudumba Unit', Mamitha Baiju thanked the technicians, co-stars and other members of the team. She acknowledged those who worked both in front of and behind the camera, recognising their contribution to the film's achievement. The 'Jana Nayagan' actress also made a special mention of her fellow cast members.'Bethlehem Kudumba Unit' enjoys box-office successDirected by Girish AD, 'Bethlehem Kudumba Unit' stars Nivin Pauly and Mamitha Baiju in the lead roles. The film arrived in theatres on August 21 and reportedly received a strong response from its opening shows. Positive word of mouth helped the movie maintain its momentum at the box office. Its collections eventually crossed Rs 300 crore, making it a major commercial success. The movie is currently streaming on OTT.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Timothee Chalamet cheers for girlfriend Kylie Jenner as she makes her Victoria's Secret Fashion Show debut in USD 50 million Fantasy Bra
articles.summary: The Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show returned to Los Angeles, with the latest edition lighting up Sony Pictures Studios in Culver City on October 18.
articles.body: The Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show returned to Los Angeles, with the latest edition lighting up Sony Pictures Studios in Culver City on October 18. The angels were back to scorch up the runway, but none shone brighter than Kylie Jenner, who made her debut at the show, modelling the brand’s latest Fantasy Bra.The beauty mogul who has become a regular at Hollywood events, supporting her beau, Timothee Chalamet, turned things around this weekend. Sunday's event saw Kylie turn show stopper, while her Oscar-nominated boyfriend, Timothee took his front-row seat to cheer her on.Paparazzi spotted the 'Dune' star turning cheerleader as he applauded Kyle from the front row, seated beside her mother, Kris Jenner. Photos and videos from the event, saw the beauty take over the runway in her dazzling diamond-studded lingerie. Interestingly, the piece of lingerie is now the most expensive 'Fantasy Bra' ever made, with a price tag of an estimated USD 50 million.Created in collaboration with luxury jewellery brand Jacob & Co., the Fantasy Bra features a striking yellow diamond centrepiece and an elaborate arrangement of natural diamonds. While the piece was initially described as a USD 22 million piece, Jacob & Co. has stated that it is "valued at USD 50 million", making it the "most valuable Fantasy Bra ever made."Announcing the collaboration on its official page, the brand wrote, "when Victoria’s Secret asked us to reimagine one of its most iconic creations, it started with a single question: what if there was no fabric at all?"Explaining the craftsmanship behind the creation, the statement added, "What began as a pencil sketch became a masterpiece of jewellery engineering. Crafted from 3,218 individually designed components, the creation moves with the body like lingerie, combining the brilliance of high jewellery with the fluidity of fashion. More than 1,000 hours to create. 15 artisans. 4,410 natural diamonds."The statement further detailed the centrepiece and the diamonds used in the design: "At its heart lies an extraordinary 75.54-carat natural Fancy Vivid Yellow diamond, surrounded by 4,409 diamonds totalling 1,373 carats, featuring an array of exceptional cuts, including Jacob & Co.’s signature Angel-Cut."The show also featured performances by Megan Thee Stallion and Tate McRae, with veteran models, including Bella Hadid and Adriana Lima, walking the runway with newer faces.Kylie and Timothee will soon be back on the red carpets with 'Dune: Part Three' promotions set to begin soon with the film gearing up for its December release.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
